description:
## Functional specifications and files
Implement composable ensure-and-edit prerequisite for canonical source references. Resolve trusted record through existing provider boundary, authorize before mutation, reuse document identity/permissions, transactionally save identity and labels only on Save. No conversion/chunks/embedding. Cover concurrent ingestion and source lifecycle.
Files/owners: Ingestion source identity/document permission owner, focused validated Action only if audit proves missing; Ingestion API/Event builder and existing source tests.
## Tests to add before implementation
Extend source/document/editor boundary tests for unauthorized/nil actors, idempotency, concurrent first ingestion, canonical provider/config collisions, rollback/cancel, source-derived permission projection, tombstones and no model config.
## Branches/paths validated
Success, invalid input, nil/denied actor, stale/concurrent write, unavailable/deleted source, lifecycle cleanup and failure rollback where relevant. No hidden cross-service calls.
## Mocking plan
Real Repo, validated Actions, NodeRouter and domain boundaries. Mock only external provider/conversion HTTP when relevant; runtime dependencies via existing Zaq.Config opts, no global mutation.
## Documentation
Update owner module docs and relevant existing service/BO guide alongside behavior; durable evidence here. Follow docs/documentation.md.
## Action reuse assessment
New focused prerequisite operation if no existing one fits, backed by Document.insert_new, ExternalSource and ExternalPermissions; trusted canonical source+actor+typed edits/versions -> identity/projection or typed errors. BO consumes via NodeRouter only. Audit must fix exact ownership before implementation.
## Validation/dependencies
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Scoped tests + mix q only per implementation issue. Final precommit reserved for final child. Supervisor verifies before closure. New feature E2E remains zaq-kw0.15 -> zaq-kw0.16.
